# Comparison of methods

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## When to use each method

### Least squares

- [Exploratory analysis]{style="color: tomato;"}, where a quick point estimate is enough
- Obtaining [initial values]{style="color: tomato;"} for likelihood-based or Bayesian methods
- Situations where [computational speed]{style="color: tomato;"} matters and a simple error structure is acceptable

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum likelihood

- Whenever [uncertainty quantification]{style="color: tomato;"} is required
- [Model comparison and selection]{style="color: tomato;"} between candidate models
- Data with [overdispersion]{style="color: tomato;"} or other non-constant error structures
- [Formal statistical inference]{style="color: tomato;"} for reports and publications

------------------------------------------------------------------------
